svg.title: From the car to the steering
svg.desc: The steering gear sits across the front axle region. The driver reaches it through a column; hydraulic lines connect it to the belt-driven pump on the engine behind the seats. The column turns the pinion, the rack moves both track rods, and the front carriers steer. The pump assists that mechanical path. The rim supports the tyre at its bead seats; the tyre meets the road. Numbered parts: 1 Wheel and column; 2 Rack and assistance; 3 Pump and reservoir; 4 Supply and return; 5 Left rod and carrier; 6 Right rod and carrier; 7 17-inch front rim; 8 Front tyre and beads. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
